stories.title: SEC elimination games, tests for new top two and 26 other things to watch in CFB Week 8
stories.summary: Ole Miss, Tennessee and LSU face road challenges, while Miami and BYU try to avoid the upset bug.

stories.title: Sources: Jags LT Harrison out for season after surgery reveals torn ACL
stories.summary: Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison will miss the rest of the season because of a torn ACL in his right knee, league sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Colts QB Richardson charged with possession of marijuana
stories.summary: Colts quarterback Anthony Richardson Sr. is facing a misdemeanor charge for marijuana possession following a traffic stop earlier this month, court records show.

stories.title: Fever president Krauskopf steps down after 2nd stint with team
stories.summary: Fever president Kelly Krauskopf, who oversaw the team as it made the playoffs for 12 consecutive seasons, has stepped down from her position.

stories.title: Sources: Devils land 3-time Vezina winner Hellebuyck from Jets
stories.summary: The Devils made a major move Friday, acquiring goalie and 3-time Vezina Trophy winner Connor Hellebuyck from the Jets, sources told ESPN.
